mathematics.logical_review: Current new proofs were written and audited independently by the root and two specialist AI agents. The N4 three-divisibility proof was checked for weighted Laurent component comparison, Hopf pole lower bound, convergence and divergence at the heavy-w boundary, simple-kernel perturbation, all-s moment inequalities, domain/minimal-exactness tail bound and numerical-period Hilbert reduction. The nozz proofs were checked for triple grading, finite folded Frobenius pairing, the surjection/dimension argument proving injectivity, each local mixed rank, generalized one-heavy GS and descent of quotient presentations/periods. The explicit formal matrix obstruction was checked algebraically. These are internal mathematical audits, not formalization, external peer review or verified novelty. Existing exact certificates remain retained with their verified scope; no new theorem depends on an enumeration.
mathematics.scope: For arbitrary n>=1, determine indexed two-step Ore structure of word-quadratic AS-regular Z-domains with primitive jumps (1^n,2,3). The main all-n reduction now proves B-ASn if and only if every r3(i)=n,r5(i)=1; those two rank conditions imply the full indexed two-step Ore structure without H, Koszulity, noetherianity or initial B-AS. Thus only their automaticity remains for unconditional indexed exhaustion. This automaticity is proved for n=1,2,3; n2,n3 also descend to ordinary Ore. At n4, D=L-N=3 is unconditional and ten conditions are equivalent, including Koszulity, N6, A/B period one, uniform/standard B Hilbert rows, B-AS4, indexed/ordinary Ore, and r3=4,r5=1. Their automaticity remains open. Ordinary graded word-Koszul objects admit full two-step Ore without initial H or noetherianity. Standard bigraded row Hilbert series imply the indexed structure and Koszulity for every n. A formal n4 pure-Euler model passes all-degree positivity/growth/Hopf constraints; it is not a realized algebra. Unconditional indexed exhaustion remains open for n>=4. Additionally, r5 is forced everywhere when the AS period L is not divisible by three, and on at least one mod-three class otherwise. Every Q4dom object has 3 dividing N and L=N+3. No initial Koszul, Hilbert, noetherian or period-one assumption. If 3 does not divide L, R5 GS gives all r5=1. Nonzero w powers force det P(eps^2,eps^-1)=0; its simple-kernel coefficients give sum r4=4L and sum r3=sum p_(s-1). Pure/mixed moments force third pure Tor into word s-1. Domain cancellation and minimal exactness give each tail rank p_i>=2, so s<=6. The s5 and s6 numerical Euler matrices have positive roots inside the unit disk, contradicting polynomial growth. Hence the only unresolved non-Koszul top words are N=9,12,15,...; first N9/L12/s7. This is an analytic proof with no enumeration. The N7 ten-period formal model has no AS-domain parent extension. For any Qn_dom, add word-Koszulity and zero projection of every R4 to zz for the fixed word grading. Then all r3=r4=n,r5=1, B Koszul ASn, standard bigraded Hilbert and L=n+5 hold. Both z and w are regular normal families, giving actual periods 2 and 3 and hence period one; A descends to an ordinary two-step skew polynomial algebra B0[z;sigma][w;tau]. Finite folded Frobenius duality yields E=F+Fzeta+Feta+Fzetaeta as a direct sum of multidegrees, equal dimensions of F and E11, and injective right multiplication by zetaeta and etazeta. This forces the ranks without assuming them. No initial H, noetherian or period-one assumption. The no-zz hypothesis is additional, invariant under fixed-word/jump-preserving generator basis changes only. For any Qn_dom with zero R4-to-zz projections, all r5=1 and an actual word-preserving period L not divisible by six, all r3=r4=n and full indexed Ore over an ASn base follow without Koszulity. One-heavy GS applied successively to A/(w) and A/(z) gives normal z and w, periods two and three, and ordinary two-step skew descent. If 3 does not divide L, the all-r5 hypothesis is also unnecessary by GEN-R5-GS-SATURATION. No assertion of standard Hilbert, Koszulity or noetherianity in this non-Koszul result. Unconditional indexed exhaustion remains unresolved for n>=4.

The shift-one action is (alpha,beta)->(beta,c^(-1)alpha), giving alpha^2=c beta^2 as the exact period-one condition, including the zero pair. Shift two is always scalar-equivalent.

The excess-zero bar subcomplex is exactly the pure jump-one bar complex, with no new pure relations from positive excess.
For n3, D>=4 would give all pure-base simples projective dimension at most two; periodic row Hilbert ratios force an interior pole and exclude this.
In the pure-base numerical lemma, domain multiplication and the algebraically closed-field Segre dimension bound imply a common folded Hilbert pole of order at least two with leading coefficient cJ.
P(1)J=JP(1)=0 and JPprime(1)J=0 give r_i=2+q_i, q_i=q_(i+s-2), (s-2)sum q=L, leaving only s3 or s9.
The exceptional s9/L14 pattern folds to seven vertices and has determinant (1-u^7)^2(1-64u^7), contradicting polynomial growth at an interior positive root.
The mixed-rank row Hilbert limit gives a_i=b_(i+4), b_i=a_(i+5); period eight forces constancy. Positivity of the full inverse Hilbert polynomial forces a=b=3.
General AS-base Ore needs B itself ASn. AS pairings force D3 and r5=1, then multiplication by z dual forces r3=n, yielding a normal regular z family.
B has periods 2, L_B and L_B+5, so is period one without a commutativity assumption on periodicity maps.
The first Ore mapping cone is minimal without Koszulity. Low-excess bar components and full AS duality give all four Tor strands and the exact Hilbert product.

The weight-four relation projections are both isomorphisms by AS pairings; ordered spanning plus the exact Hilbert product proves PBW. Associativity and uniqueness prove indexed theta homomorphism and delta derivation identities.

The general R5 monomial quotient growth bound counts nonzero positions; using their sum as the count additionally uses the domain rank bound. The notes describe the exact limitation of that quotient test.

Quadratic standard Hilbert and domain give the exact left/right 1331 complexes: K3 has dimension one; its nonzero linear coefficient makes the top map injective; the remaining kernel has the same Hilbert series t^3 H. Koszulity is a conclusion of the period-two recognition theorem.

The two-period fold is an actual graded category using powers of one fixed periodicity isomorphism. Highest-degree terms preserve composable-domainness, and polynomial growth gives corner Ore fractions.
Faithful localization preserves all alternating product spaces X,Y. An independent corner realization x->xh(gh)^(-1), y->gy verifies the same multiplication and dimensions.

Domain relations contain no decomposable tensors. Segre dimension excludes flattening ranks 32/23; rank-one flattenings are also excluded. A rank22 tensor has full middle support and a rank-two defining hyperplane, yielding ua x+ub y+vb x+vc y.

For different supports U,W in a common three-dimensional X, the partial isomorphism has exactly the two cases determined by whether its common line is preserved. After framing, c q c^(-1)=lambda t or t^(-1).
The equalities dim XY=dim YX=6 force q=f(t) and c t c^(-1)=h(t) in k(t). f composed with h has degree one, so f is Möbius and dim XY<=5, contradiction.
For equal supports, conjugation by c is Möbius on k(t), and every alternating product has poles bounded by a divisor of degree O(m). This contradicts dim B_(0,2m)=binom(2m+2,2).

Nondegenerate top pairings identify dual right Koszul complexes with shifted left ones. The standard length-three Koszul bimodule resolution is split exact on each side and bounds global dimension for all unital modules.

N3-INDEXED-ORE uses numerical forcing, actual period two of B, the independent AS3 recognition theorem and the all-n conditional Ore theorem. B period one follows from periods two and AS translation three. N3-GRADED-DESCENT subsequently proves final A period one by extending the coefficient shift.

For n3, delta(R) gives mu_i(id tensor L_(i+1))+(sigma_i sigma_(i+2))(L_i tensor id)=0. Nondegenerate top tensors imply full relation supports, so adjacent correction functionals vanish together. All-zero corrections give a normal w family and period three; periods two/three give final A period one. N3-GRADED-DESCENT settles the all-nonzero branch as well.

Normal-z strict two-period framing gives sigma_i=id and c_i=1. The second Ore exchange has M_(i+2)=M_i and preserves z. Descending C via theta and the strict two-shift, with g_(i+1)=g_i M_i, makes the z and w exchange coefficients equal to one constant base automorphism S.

The coefficient identities ell_(i+2)=ell_i S and (id tensor ell_(i+1)+ell_i tensor S)(R)=0 imply a well-defined invertible T on E=span ell_i, because R has full left/right support and both projections of K are injective.
For dim E0 take P=id; for dim E1 take a scalar. For dim E3, P^2=S and flipping the tensor identity twice gives (P tensor P)r=r for every relation.

For dim E2, the exact block equations are A Q^T+Q^2 A^T=0 and c Q^T+s A^T+nu b^T=0. The kernel maps injectively to b, and the cyclicity of E rules out scalar Q. Matrix solutions and the domain prohibition on rank-one relations leave only distinct reciprocal eigenvalues or the Jordan block at one.

In the reciprocal case the simultaneous elimination of d_x and s_x, and then d_y and s_y, includes all resonances nu=lambda and nu=lambda^2. The resulting three relations are preserved by diag(lambda,lambda^(-1),1).

In the Jordan-one case the canonical unipotent square root P=S_u^(1/2) preserves R: P tensor P is the polynomial unipotent square root of the unipotent part S_u tensor S_u of S tensor S. It commutes with S and induces Q on V/W.

The resulting period-one isomorphism fixes z and w. Changing frames by P^i yields R_prime=(id tensor P)R, sigma_prime=SP^(-2), tau_prime|V=SP^(-3), delta_prime(v)=(ell_0 P^(-3))(v)z^2. The base change is a Zhang twist and need not be a graded isomorphism.

Rogalski-Zhang Lemma1.3(a) applies to C_prime in word grading, with every V and z generator in degree one. Its noetherianity and the automorphism Ore Hilbert basis theorem imply D left/right noetherian, hence all representable row/column modules of check(D) are noetherian.

Periodic pd<=3 Euler has a common folded Hilbert pole hJ of order at least two; row/column balance yields a balanced weighted graph. The symmetric Euler form is positive definite on constants-perpendicular for m>=4.

For the simple eigenvalue lambda, the Hilbert pole forces lambda_prime(1)=0. The exact identity L lambda_second(1)/2=(4-m)L/2-E_m(x)-sum a_(i,l)(l+x_i-x_(i+l))^2/2 is strictly negative, contradicting the nonnegative inverse applied to a positive eigenvector.
N4 D>=4 would kill pure Ext in degrees 4,5,6, contradicting the pd3 obstruction. D>=3 follows from domain R6=0 and the weight-five growth obstruction.
N4 pure resolution shifts, q_i=r5(i+s), q in {0,1}, not all zero, row rank balance and first Laurent moment all follow before assuming Koszulity.
For n4 N6, p_i=2+q_i+q_(i-1),r_i=5+q_(i-1); P_B=F(F^2-u^2 Delta S^2)F. Any missing q makes a nonnegative G spectral radius cross one inside (0,1), contradicting polynomial growth.

N4 mixed AS complement shifts are c_(i+5),b_(i+5),a_(i+6); row and first-moment identities give b_i=a_(i+5),c_i=a_i+a_(i+1)-2. Exact P=F K F and adj((I-S)^2)=9J imply det K(1,v)=-9(sum alpha_i)v+O(v^2).

A nonzero mixed defect gives a Hilbert pole of order at most two for fixed small positive v, contrary to coefficientwise domination of the pure-base pole of order four. Thus all standard ranks/H and periods two/nine give period one.

N4 uniform pure Hilbert rows imply identical scalar Euler polynomials, q_i=1 and positive common r. Unit roots and reciprocity contradict r=-p_(s-2)<=0 for s>=5. Intrinsic B is preserved by bare A period-one maps, giving the first six of the ten equivalent criteria.

For ordinary finite Koszul polynomial-growth algebras, root products force top Betti one and generator number <= global dimension; equality forces all roots one. Applied to pure B and A, domain relation projections and AS complementary strands force all standard bigraded numerics.
Alternating bar tensors are nonzero over k or a product of vertex fields, and have no incoming boundary in their diagonal word degree.
Normal-square cancellation occurs in the original domain, not in its quotient; nonzero v,w survive the quotient because their jumps differ from z.

Rogalski-Zhang Lemma1.1/Corollary1.2 applies in word degree one without noetherianity. The finite semisimple extension is proved via the two-row spectral sequence and minimum internal degree, not an unjustified degeneration claim.

The finite-fold quotient preserves jump grading and unfolds finite simple resolutions/AS shifts; separability of the degree-zero algebra gives a finite minimal bimodule resolution for all unital modules.
Indexed standard-H theorem assumes the full two-variable row Hilbert series. The normal-z mixed-rank theorem has no H/Koszul assumption and does not alone claim non-Koszul PBW.

For the Koszul normal-z theorem, the w-count-zero normalized bar summand identifies Ext_B and proves B Koszul before transferring the Frobenius form. The top w-count is uniformly one; eta multiplication is an isomorphism.
The n4 pure-Euler certificate uses a cofactor-degree bound and a 40-residue quadratic formula to prove positivity and Hopf inequalities for all degrees. It does not construct an algebra.
The coefficient -942 is the individual pencil obstruction. The separate three-divisibility theorem excludes every AS-domain parent extension of the N7 pure formal model.
The exact w^j coefficient ideal is I_j=F(R+mu R+...+mu^j R)F; mu(R)=R is not assumed in this step. Stabilization takes place in finite-dimensional F2.
The highest Q bidegree has J=(L_A-N_A-1)/2 and a=N_A-1-J, uniform over the folded vertices. Nonnegative bar bidegrees and AS duality imply J>=1.

P_J=(-1)^d*x^a*Pi*P_0(x^-1)^T is invertible over Q((x)); therefore P_J G_N cannot vanish. The equation P G=I-tT forces J1 and G constant. This is not an invalid determinant or arbitrary-matrix degree argument.

Equal Hilbert matrices for the nested coefficient ideals imply equality in every finite component; the degree-two comparison gives mu(R)=R. Returning to the original cover gives a regular normal jump-three family and the second AS quotient.

The new periodic R5 saturation proof was independently checked by the root and two agents. The explicit positive-weight curve respects b^2=ac and convergence; the Poisson correction of an orbit-constant positive left vector avoids any unjustified analytic perturbation of a multiple zero eigenvalue. Only one saturated mod-three class is concluded when 3 divides L.
The N4 top-word theorem covers every N not divisible by three, not merely a fixed N7 formal model. Its remaining non-Koszul words are N=9,12,15,... .

Nozz is explicitly additional and invariant only for the fixed word grading and jump-preserving basis changes. Koszulity is required in the Frobenius recognition result; the second periodic result replaces it by all r5=1 and an actual period not divisible by six.
General pure tail lower bounds sum_j p_ij>=2q_i and r2_i>=3+q_i follow from cancellation and minimal exactness even without word concentration.
The formal matrix generator-bound obstruction is not an algebra and fails domain component comparison; it is not a counterexample to the target theorem.
